items.title: COTY ANNOUNCES FOURTH QUARTER FISCAL YEAR 2026 RESULTS
items.summary: NEW YORK -- August 19, 2026 -- Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) ("Coty" or "the Company") today announced its results for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, ended June 30, 2026. Coty delivered Q4 and FY26 sales, profit, and cash flow ahead of expectations, supported by cost control and the convergence of sales and sell-out.

items.title: COTY APPOINTS SORAYA BENCHIKH CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
items.summary: NEW YORK, 19 August 2026 - Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) ("Coty" or "the Company") today announced the appointment of Soraya Benchikh as Chief Financial Officer (CFO), effective September 1, 2026. Benchikh succeeds Laurent Mercier.

items.title: COTY ANNOUNCES AGREEMENT WITH KERING FOR EARLY TRANSITION OF GUCCI BEAUTY LICENSE
items.summary: New York, 7 July 2026 – Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) (“Coty” or “the Company”) today announced that it has entered into an agreement to transition the Gucci Beauty license back to Kering for a consideration of approximately $400 million. Under the terms of the agreement, Coty will continue to operate the Gucci Beauty brand through at least June 30, 2027, ending the license approximately one year ahead of the original license term.

items.title: Coty "Supercharge with AI" Enterprise Upskilling Program Wins Newsweek AI Impact Award
items.summary: NEW YORK – May 13, 2026 – Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY), (“Coty” or “the Company”) one of the world's largest beauty companies, today announced that its enterprise AI literacy program, "Supercharge with AI: Scaling Enterprise-Wide AI Literacy & Adoption to Transform How Coty Works," (Supercharge with AI), has been named a winner of Newsweek’s AI Impact Award in the “AI Workplace: Best Outcomes, Employee Engagement” category.

items.summary: New York, May 4, 2026 -- Coty, one of the world's largest beauty companies, and Pencil, the world's #1 generative AI marketing platform, today announced a partnership to put real-time, AI-powered content creation at the heart of Coty's Consumer Beauty division.

items.title: Earth Day milestone: Coty’s Net Zero Targets Validated by the Science Based Targets initiative
items.summary: NEW YORK – April 22, 2026 -- Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY), one of the world’s largest beauty companies, today announced that the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) has validated the company’s net zero commitment for FY2050 under the Net Zero Standard. This approval confirms that Coty’s near and long-term goals align with the latest climate science, supporting global efforts to limit warming to 1.5°C.

items.title: COTY UNVEILS THE BRIDGERTON FRAGRANCE COLLECTION THAT WILL ENCHANT THE TON

items.title: GRAVITY DOESN’T STAND A CHANCE RIMMEL LONDON & RED BULL DELIVER GRAVITY DEFYING LASHES & THRILLING BEAM ROUTINE STUNT
items.summary: London, 15th January 2026: Today, the generation defying beauty brand, Rimmel London has joined forced with Red Bull, to create a once-in-a-lifetime performance, that takes Red Bull athlete and five time national All-American gymnast, Lily Smith out of the gym and up to new heights. items.title: COTY APPOINTS MARKUS STROBEL EXECUTIVE CHAIRMAN AND INTERIM CEO
items.summary: NEW YORK – [December 22, 2025] Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) (“Coty” or “the Company”) today announced that Markus Strobel will become Executive Chairman of the Board and Interim Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2026.
